description_en: Queries a list of DDoS attack events
description_zh: 该接口用于查询DDoS攻击事件列表
name: DescribeDDoSAllEventList

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
查询的起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The time span between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 31 days. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used as the end time
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
开始结束时间跨度最长不超过31天。

不设置该参数表示选取当前时间作为查询的结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of the DDoS attack event to query. Valid values:
web-cc: web resource exhaustion attacks.
cc: connection flood attacks.
traffic: volumetric traffic attacks.

If the Settings for this parameter are not specified, web resource exhaustion attack events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的DDoS攻击事件的类型。取值：
web-cc：表示Web资源耗尽型攻击。
cc：表示连接型攻击。
traffic：表示流量型攻击。

不设置该参数表示查询Web资源耗尽型攻击事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 5, 10, and 20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

DataList.description_en: The list of DDoS attack events

Bps.description_en: The peak BPS of volumetric traffic attacks

Coverage.description_en:
The attack region. Valid values:

domestic: the Chinese mainland only.
global: global.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland)
Coverage.description_zh:
攻击区域。取值：

domestic：仅中国内地。
global：全球。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）

Cps.description_en: The peak CPS of the connection flood attack

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the DDoS attack event. The time is displayed in UTC and must be in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
EndTime.description_zh:
DDoS攻击事件的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

EventResult.description_en:
The event result. Valid values:

clean: traffic scrubbed.
ratelimit: rate limited.
blackhole: blackhole filtering
EventResult.description_zh:
事件结果。取值：

clean：成功清洗。
ratelimit：限速。
blackhole：黑洞

EventType.description_en:
The type of the DDoS attack event. Valid values:
web-cc: web resource exhaustion attacks.
cc: connection flood attacks.
traffic: volumetric traffic attacks
EventType.description_zh:
待查询的DDoS攻击事件的类型。取值：
web-cc：表示Web资源耗尽型攻击。
cc：表示连接型攻击。
traffic：表示流量型攻击

Pps.description_en: The peak PPS of volumetric traffic attacks

Qps.description_en: The peak QPS of the web resource exhaustion attack

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the DDoS attack event. The time is displayed in UTC and must be in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format
StartTime.description_zh:
DDoS攻击事件的起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

TargetId.description_en: The ID of the attack target for web resource exhaustion

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
